reasons: Red: CCC credit spread (OAS), AI basket drawdown / momentum, Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL), Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Amber: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety), VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) expensive

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 3.23% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +8bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (-0.1pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 12bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.1bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 169 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 110 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 20.0 sits at the 82th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 10.5, so implied carries +9.5 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Oracle shares fall nearly 9% as CoreWeave bond scare spreads; Oracle 5y CDS hits record ~288 bps
items.note: Record Oracle CDS widening shows CoreWeave distress contagion into a hyperscaler-adjacent investment-grade AI borrower.

items.headline: CoreWeave bonds trade at distressed levels, yields near 15%; CDS reportedly ~1,000-1,200 bps
items.note: Bonds near 77 cents on the dollar signal the market pricing meaningful default risk for the largest neocloud borrower, though no default or downgrade has occurred.

items.headline: CoreWeave's debt stress tests private credit's AI financing boom
items.note: Concentrated counterparty exposure (Microsoft, OpenAI, Meta) makes private-credit AI lending vulnerable if neocloud refinancing tightens.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
